channel.desc: Select 5 countries from different continents per week and exchange programs. Arirang TV strives to improve international relationships through broadcasting and cultural exchanges based on equality, openness, and reliability. We have been airing various programs of 23 broadcasters from 21 nations worldwide, while Arirang's outstanding programs are aired on partner broadcasters' TV channels.History of DISCOVER WORLD (Previously SWAP WORLD). 2009 : Launch SWAP ASIA. Collaborate with several broadcasters in Asia.[Partners] China, India, Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Uzbekistan, Iran, Azerbaijan, Thailand. 2010 : Launch SWAP WORLD. Build relations with more countries around the world.[Partners] Russia, Hungary, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Guatemala, India, Fiji, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan, China. 2012 : Integrate SWAP ASIA and SWAP WORLD ?
